value.rationale: The first nonsmooth motivic-MZV toric base is a distinguished naturally presented projective threefold. Its integral Weil–Cartier defect is not determined by dimension, degree, normality, or the known local singularity types. The computed Z/2 component distinguishes the hyperplane class from its saturation in Cl and provides explicit obstruction and input for divisor and resolution geometry.
